# Google Analytics 4 (GA4) MCP Server

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Google Analytics 4 data exploration, schema discovery, and real-time metrics.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx google-analytics-mcp`
- NPX: `npx -y google-analytics-mcp`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://ga4.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://ga4.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `get_ga4_data(dimensions, metrics, date_ranges, limit)`: Runs structured reports.
- `list_accounts()`: Lists accessible GA accounts.
- `list_properties(account_id)`: Lists properties.
- `get_property_metadata(property_id)`: Fetches dimensions and metrics schema.
- `run_realtime_report(metrics, dimensions)`: Fetches live active users.
- `search_skills(query)`: Searches analytical recipes.

## Environment Variables
- `GA4_PROPERTY_ID`: Default GA4 property ID.
- `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`: Path to service account JSON key file.
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
